outcome: Requirement of surfactant therapy (initial and repeated doses)
cohort: A total of 60 preterm infants with Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).
finding: Lung NIRS (L-NIRS) values of ≤ 85% at NICU admission significantly predict early surfactant requirement with 57% sensitivity and 73% specificity, and lower mean basal L-NIRS values in the first 4 hours of life can guide repeated doses of surfactant.
followup_time: 4 hours after birth (for repeated surfactant assessment)
